resource_limit_scope: Inherited 16 GiB per-process RLIMIT_AS throughout, plus 0.25-second ancestry polling from launch with an aggregate 16 GiB cleanup policy and PID-start-time checks. Polling is not a kernel-enforced aggregate memory limit and may miss short-lived processes.

runtime_thread_control_evidence.interpretation: The initial original workflow failed because generated Wolfram children still had ParallelThreadNumber=384 despite OMP/MKL environment limits. The retry applies official ParallelOptions thread limits to the parent and every generated script. Original AMFlow computational files are unchanged; all symbolic cache state is fresh.

observed_complex_comparison.scope: Observed differences between stored original and native coefficients, separate from each result's precision evidence and the declared recorded-accuracy assertion.

new_cold_run_scope: The prior 1800-second attempt is retained separately. This run starts from a fresh private upstream copy and empty application cache, with the explicitly declared3600-second cap; its process time includes its own complete setup and evaluation only.
zero_component_policy: An original real or imaginary value equal to numeric zero, whether exact or finite-accuracy approximate zero, is checked with an absolute 1e-20 floor. Nonzero components use five units at their recorded Wolfram Accuracy. Fixture allowances are additionally retained for fixture comparisons.
